description_en: Queries the IP address whitelist of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的IP白名单
name: DescribeSecurityIps

SecurityIpGroup.description_en: The IP address whitelist group information of the instance
SecurityIpGroup.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组信息

items.description_en: The IP address whitelist group information of the instance
items.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组信息

SecurityIpGroupAttribute.description_en:
The attribute of the IP address whitelist group. This parameter is empty by default.
A hidden group indicates a whitelist group that is automatically generated by the system (such as DAS, DMS, or DTS) after user authorization. These whitelist groups cannot be modified or deleted
SecurityIpGroupAttribute.description_zh:
IP白名单分组属性，默认为空。
hidden分组表示经用户授权后，系统（DAS、DMS、DTS等）自动生成的白名单分组，此类白名单分组不支持修改、删除操作。

SecurityIpGroupName.description_en: The name of the IP address whitelist group

SecurityIpList.description_en: The list of IP addresses in the IP address whitelist group. A maximum of 1,000 IP addresses are supported
SecurityIpList.description_zh: IP白名单分组下的IP列表，最多1000个
